author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The U.S. government accused six Chinese artificial-intelligence companies Tuesday of maliciously copying American technology through large-scale model distillation, escalating a dispute over how advanced AI systems are built and protected.

Reuters reported that officials named DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Alibaba among the companies accused of using outputs from models developed by Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and SpaceX. Distillation is a common technical approach in which a smaller model learns from the responses of a larger one, but providers can restrict automated extraction or uses that violate their terms.

U.S. officials argued that the activity could speed Chinese research and strengthen military or cyber capabilities. The allegations arrived ahead of planned U.S.-China discussions on AI safety and a meeting between Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.

The claims are government allegations, not a court finding. Reuters said the Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond. The next issue is whether the administration follows the statement with export controls, sanctions or enforcement against companies and intermediaries, steps that could further split the global AI supply chain.
dek: Officials say companies including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Alibaba used American model outputs at scale to accelerate their own systems.
headline: U.S. accuses six Chinese AI firms of malicious model copying
